Hair Transplant Services in Bangalore

Advanced hair restoration procedures for men, women, beard, eyebrows, and corrective cases.
Neo Follicle offers different types of hair transplant procedures depending on the patient’s need, donor area, hair loss pattern, and aesthetic goal. Each procedure is planned after proper scalp evaluation and consultation with the doctor.

Hair Transplant For Male

Restore a natural-looking hairline and improve bald or thinning areas.

Male hair transplant is commonly performed for receding hairline, frontal baldness, crown thinning, and male pattern baldness. At Neo Follicle, the treatment plan is based on the grade of baldness, future hair loss risk, donor hair strength, and desired density.

Learn More About Direct Hair Transplant

Hair Transplant For Female

Hair restoration for women with thinning hair, visible scalp, or female pattern hair loss.

Female hair transplant requires careful diagnosis because women can experience hair loss due to hormonal, nutritional, genetic, stress-related, or medical causes. At Neo Follicle, female hair restoration is planned only after understanding the cause and suitability.

Learn More About Female Hair Transplant

Failed Hair Transplant Repair

Correct unnatural hairlines, poor density, scarring, or previous transplant concerns.

Patients who are unhappy with an earlier hair transplant may need a detailed evaluation before repair. Neo Follicle assesses the previous graft placement, donor area condition, scalp health, and realistic correction options.

Learn More About Failed Hair Transplant

Beard Transplant

Fill patchy beard areas and improve beard shape and density.

Beard transplant is suitable for men with patchy beard growth, scars, thin moustache, or uneven facial hair. The procedure uses hair follicles from the donor area and places them carefully to match the direction and angle of natural beard growth.

Learn More About Beard Transplant

Eyebrow Restoration

Restore eyebrow shape, fullness, and symmetry with precise follicle placement.

Eyebrow restoration is useful for people with thin eyebrows, over-plucked eyebrows, scars, or eyebrow hair loss. The procedure requires fine planning because eyebrow hair direction, angle, and density are very different from scalp hair.

Learn More About Eyebrow Restoration

Body Hair Transplant

An option for selected patients with limited scalp donor hair.

In some cases, body hair may be considered as an additional donor source when scalp donor hair is limited. Suitability depends on hair texture, growth cycle, body hair availability, and the goal of restoration.

Learn More About Body Hair Transplant

Unshaven Hair Transplant

A discreet hair transplant option for selected patients.

Unshaven hair transplant may be suitable for patients who prefer minimal visible change during the procedure period. It is planned based on donor area, graft requirement, hair length, and the complexity of the case.

Learn More About Body Hair Transplant

Hair Loss Treatments in Bangalore

Non-surgical treatments for hair fall, thinning hair, early-stage hair loss, and scalp-related concerns.
Not every patient with hair loss needs a hair transplant. Many people, especially in the early stages of hair thinning or hair fall, may benefit from non-surgical hair loss treatments.

Neo Follicle offers a range of medical and regenerative hair loss treatments that may help improve hair density, reduce hair fall, support weak follicles, and improve scalp health. The right treatment depends on the cause of hair loss, stage of thinning, age, medical history, and doctor’s diagnosis.
View All Hair Loss Treatments

Neo-Follicle Stem Cell Therapy

A regenerative hair loss treatment that activates dormant hair follicles using stem cell technology, promoting stronger and thicker hair regrowth naturally.
Learn More About Stem Cell Therapy

PRP-Platelet-Rich Plasma Therapy

A clinically proven hair regrowth therapy that uses platelet-rich plasma from your own blood to stimulate hair follicles, improve density, and slow hair loss.
Learn More About PRP Treatment

Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) Therapy

A next-generation growth factor-based treatment that enhances hair follicle strength, reduces hair thinning, and promotes long-term regrowth with zero side effects.
Learn More About GFC Treatment

Neo QR678 Treatment

A revolutionary peptide-based therapy designed to reduce hair fall and boost hair regrowth, clinically tested for both men and women suffering from hair thinning.
Learn More About QR678 Treatment

Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT)

A non-invasive, painless laser treatment that uses low-level laser light to improve blood circulation in the scalp, enhancing hair follicle health and growth.
Learn More About LLLT

Scalp Hair Micro-Pigmentation (MPG)

A non-surgical cosmetic treatment that creates the illusion of fuller hair by using specialized pigments, ideal for camouflaging bald spots or adding scalp density.
Learn More About Scalp MPG

Exosome Therapy

A cutting-edge stem cell-derived treatment that delivers growth factors and proteins directly to hair follicles, accelerating natural hair regeneration and reducing inflammation.
Learn More About Exosome Therapy

Are You the Right Candidate for Hair Transplant?

Hair transplant is suitable only when the donor area, hair loss pattern, and expectations are medically appropriate.

You may be a suitable candidate for hair transplant if you have:

  • Receding hairline
  • Male pattern baldness
  • Crown baldness
  • Stable hair loss
  • Good donor hair at the back or sides of the scalp
  • Patchy beard or moustache growth
  • Thin or missing eyebrows
  • Hair loss after injury, scar, or previous surgery
  • Unsatisfactory result from an earlier hair transplant

However, hair transplant may not be the first option for every patient. If your hair loss is active, diffuse, medically driven, or temporary, the doctor may first recommend medical or non-surgical hair loss treatment.

Check If You Are Suitable.

What Happens During Your Hair Transplant Journey?

From consultation to recovery, we guide you at every step.

1. Consultation and Scalp Evaluation

The doctor evaluates your hair loss pattern, donor area, scalp condition, age, expectations, and medical history.

2. Treatment Planning

If hair transplant is suitable, the doctor discusses the number of grafts, hairline design, donor area plan, procedure method, and expected result.

3. Hairline Design

A natural-looking hairline is designed based on your facial structure, age, hair loss pattern, and long-term appearance.

4. Graft Extraction and Implantation

Hair follicles are carefully extracted from the donor area and implanted into thinning or bald areas with attention to angle, direction, and density.

5. Recovery and Follow-Up

You receive post-procedure care instructions, follow-up guidance, and long-term maintenance advice to support the result.

Natural-Looking Results Begin With Realistic Planning

Hair transplant results depend on donor hair quality, graft survival, hair loss stage, and long-term maintenance.
A good hair transplant should not look artificial. The transplanted hair should blend with your existing hair and match the natural direction, angle, and pattern of growth.

At Neo Follicle, we help patients understand the complete result journey. Hair transplant results take time. Initial shedding can happen after the procedure. New growth usually appears gradually, and density improves over several months.

The final result depends on many factors, including:

  • Number of grafts implanted
  • Quality of donor hair
  • Hair thickness and texture
  • Scalp health
  • Grade of baldness
  • Graft survival
  • Post-procedure care
  • Future hair loss control
